_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Mwari {player_id} mumhango waLiar's Dice wenharo {num_players}-player.
Mienzaniso:
- Pahwandei, unogona kucherechedza kana:
  1) Uvhe tsvimbo utsva kubva kwauso kwenyu kubva pauso [Bid: 3, 4],
  2) Udze mwakapeni mwakapeni '[Call]'.

Ukati udze:
  - Iwe kuzungu kwauso uko chidoko kuliko tsvimbo, anobisha mwakapeni akapera tsvimbo rimwe.
  - Kana kuna kwazvo, udze akapera tsvimbo rimwe.
Mwari akapera tsvimbo dzeake anowana kudzingwa. Mwari wechishiri anotsva.

board.new_round:
Mwaka mitsva - Tsvimbo dzerudo: {dice_summary}
Tsvimbo dzauno dziri kuna: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} calls! The actual count of face {face_value} is {count}, which is LESS than {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (the last bidder) loses one die.
call.caller_loses:
Mwari {current_player_id} akudza! Kuzungu kwauso {face_value} kunowanikwa {count}, ambayo ndiyo >= {quantity}.
Mwari {loser_id} (akudza) akapera tsvimbo rimwe.

invalid_move.not_recognized: Shanda harikwanisi kuzivikanwa kana '[Bid: X, Y]' kana '[Call]' chete. Shanda rakapihwa: {action}

bid_reason.face_lower: Mutengo mutsva wezita {new_face_value} wakaderera pane uripo iye zvino {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.face_range: Kukosha kunofanira kuva pakati pe1 ne6.
